user.title: Add a Kamst-IR gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway's address. Each gateway becomes its own device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the gateway.
data_description.port: Web server port of the gateway, normally 82.
data_description.name: Device name in Home Assistant, for example "Kamstrup K1".
data_description.meter_type: Decides which sensors are enabled by default. You can enable any sensor later.
data_description.mode: REST polls the gateway. MQTT receives the values the gateway publishes to your MQTT broker.

mqtt.title: MQTT topic prefix
mqtt.description: Enter the topic base the gateway publishes under: the part before `/reading/…` and `/smart_gateways/…`. If the PREFIX field in the gateway's web UI is blank this is `kamstir`. Each gateway needs its own, for example `{example}`.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the gateway
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway's address or MQTT prefix. Entities and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway. Check the host and port.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like a Kamst-IR gateway (no JSON readings or no MAC address).
error.invalid_prefix: Enter a topic prefix without the wildcards + or #.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.
error.prefix_in_use: Another gateway already uses this topic prefix.

abort.mqtt_not_configured: Set up the MQTT integration first, then add the gateway again.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different gateway (the MAC address does not match).

data_description.scan_interval: REST mode only. The gateway reads the meter optically at its own interval, so polling faster than that adds nothing.
data_description.mode: REST polls the gateway. MQTT receives the values the gateway publishes.
data_description.mqtt_prefix: Required for MQTT mode. `kamstir` if the gateway's PREFIX field is blank.

error.invalid_prefix: Enter a topic prefix without the wildcards + or #.
error.mqtt_not_configured: Set up the MQTT integration first.
error.prefix_in_use: Another gateway already uses this topic prefix.

install_needs_mqtt.message: Firmware can only be installed when the gateway is connected in MQTT mode.

restart_auth_required.message: The gateway asked for a login to restart. Restart it from its web UI instead.

legacy_yaml_entities.title: Old Kamst-IR YAML sensors still exist
legacy_yaml_entities.description:
{count} entities from the old MQTT YAML package still exist: {entities}.

The Kamst-IR Gateway integration now provides these sensors. Delete the gateway's packages file (for example `packages/kamstir_k1.yaml`) and restart Home Assistant, so you don't end up with duplicate sensors. Nothing is deleted automatically.
